title: Continuative
summary: CONTINUATIVE, noun 1. An expression noting permanence or duration. To these may be added continuatives; as, Rome remains to this day; which includes at least two propositions, viz. Rome was, and Rome

inlines.v: CONTINUATIVE, noun 1. An expression noting permanence or duration. To these may be added continuatives; as, Rome remains to this day; which includes at least two propositions, viz. Rome was, and Rome is. 2. In grammar, a word that continues.
